validation_results.champion_party_levels_note: Recorded as final_party_levels in the original receipt. These are the Champion's fixed party levels, identical in every run, not this run's own party. Our party levels were not captured by the run report at the time and cannot be recovered.

validation_results.failure: A failed wild-battle flee fainted the active member, and the duplicated forced-party-menu cursor loop could not select the observed living party member.

diagnosis: The failed-flee and wild-capture paths retained separate cursor-address heuristics instead of using the shared observed forced-switch primitive. The local cursor could be active without responding to the assumed numeric up/down progression, exhausting the inner selection bound.
repair_direction: Route both wild-battle forced-switch paths through the shared semantic switch controller, source party health from the observation adapter, and preserve the exact encounter identity before resuming flee or capture.
